title: The Outfall Beyond Listening

features.name: the grating where speech becomes current
features.desc-on-touch: Water carries voices deeper than air ever could. You read them as they flow.

features.name: pool of accumulated silence
features.desc-on-touch: Still water holds what was never meant to be heard. The archive listened, then chose not to record.

features.name: culvert-rows fading outward
features.desc-on-touch: The drains continue beyond any town. Concrete becomes indistinguishable from earth at the edge.

features.name: the stone curve where echo learns restraint
features.desc-on-touch: Your voice reaches this point and stops. What comes back is not what you sent.

features.name: weir-board holding back permission
features.desc-on-touch: The archive's choice made physical: this structure decides what flows and what stays trapped.

inscription: here the outfall learns that distance is another name for love

file.name: Drainage_Manifest_1997-2014.txt
file.note: Flow records for the western system; each entry corrupted to show only the moment it ceased to be private speech and became shared current

reverie.title: REVERIE — standing in the culvert mouth
narr: You both stood where the drain opened toward
the wider water. Katita said: we could record
this, but we shouldn't. She meant: some words
need to flow away. You understood then that
listening was sometimes the cruelest choice.

exits.label: farther into the delta where water forgets its source
toward the tidal mouth where drains meet ocean
